ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake Ninefold (M0 — safe core)
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
The safe core of the divine-satiation engine (design/Jawa/divine_satiation_engine.md), M0 slice: a nine-god satiation/mood vector, the band ladder (Wrathful/Slighted/Neutral/Content/Exalted), a per-god Mood random walk, and five Harmony-patched event hooks (research completed, mental break started, birth outcome, building deconstructed, building repaired) binding real RimWorld events to ApplyDelta calls.
Other RimMandrake systems (e.g. the colony visibility dial) read this engine's satiation state to drive their own effects.
NOT shipped here (NINEFOLD_ENGINE_M0_1's other named pieces, deliberately left for a later session): first-contact chains and the signed corpus letters - the latter needs the owner's voice-text redline pass per the item's own note ("provisional voice approval; owner redlines live text"). Mood-walk amplitudes and event magnitudes are a first-pass encoding of the spec's qualitative personality column, explicitly UNTUNED (design/Jawa/divine_satiation_engine.md §10 defers real tuning to a throwaway-save test rig).
